card.line: Assyria was a strong empire north of Babylonia along the Tigris River, whose kings attacked Israel and Judah and carried the Israelites away from their land.

moments.title: Israelites Taken to Assyria
moments.text: The king of Assyria surrounded Samaria for three years and then captured it. He carried the Israelites away to Assyria and settled them in Halah, Gozan, and the cities of the Medes.

problems.problem: Most moments still describe Assyria’s actions or influence outside Assyria; only the third includes people being taken there.
